# Code of Conduct
 
## Our Pledge
 
This project aims to be a welcoming and respectful place for everyone who
wants to use it, report problems, ask questions, or contribute.
 
## Expected Behavior
 
- Be respectful and kind to others
- Give and accept constructive feedback gracefully
- Stay on topic and assume good faith
- Respect different experience levels, backgrounds, and opinions

## Unacceptable Behavior
 
- Harassment, insults, or personal attacks
- Discriminatory or sexualized language or imagery
- Trolling or deliberately disruptive behavior
- Publishing others' private information without permission
- Any other conduct that would be inappropriate in a professional setting

## Scope
 
This Code of Conduct applies to all project spaces, including issues, pull
requests, discussions, and any other place where the project is represented.
 
## Enforcement
 
The maintainer may edit, hide, or remove comments, issues, pull requests, and
other contributions that violate this Code of Conduct, and may temporarily or
permanently ban anyone who engages in unacceptable behavior.
 
To report a violation, contact the maintainer at minchoste@gmail.com.
Reports will be handled promptly and kept confidential.
 
## Attribution
 
This Code of Conduct is a simplified version inspired by the
[Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org), version 2.1.
